method: Fresh evaluator received only an isolated skill copy, request, requirements, and raw fixtures. Parent retained acceptance checks and independently ran them against the resulting work directory.
reproduce: Copy fixtures to a temporary directory, replace display.py with this run's display.py, then run python3 -B evaluations/diff-simplification/acceptance.py TEMP_DIRECTORY and python3 -B -m unittest -v from TEMP_DIRECTORY.
limits: One synthetic forward trial, not an effectiveness comparison.
No matched no-skill baseline, host routing test, or production validation.
Other declared cases remain not run.
Revisions to design, TDD, debugging, and review guidance received static validation and separate review, not behavioral performance trials.
